source_workbook.article: Venkatesh,S.,Kosoy,R.,Wu,Z.,et al. Single-nucleus transcriptome-wide association study of human brain disorders. Nature657,1016-1026(2026).
source_workbook.changes: Four original integer counts extracted and reordered as finer novel/known,comparator novel/known;original counts unchanged. Each source row is tested with explicitly declared pseudocount0 and1. The 40 complete correction families reuse all 422 source count tables;each family also contains one explicit missing-count placeholder. No synthetic count table is included in this reference population.

scope: Every source table16/17 row in full26/396-test families,plus one explicitly missing table per family. Rawprobability correction uses unmodifiedRstats::p.adjust;finite-log correction is an independent R extension. No historical method or group-membership inference;rawsourcecounts and attribution retained.
